pois.name: Shelter / Hejnum Church
pois.note:
A small wooden house next to the church in Hejnum, 
s always open to pilgrims. 
There are two doors. The door to be used is at the back of the house..
If the door is locked, the key hangs just to the right of the door. 
In the small house you will find; water, toilet, kitchen, 
inflatable mattresses and also some kind of energy.
 It will be possible to charge electrical equipment.

pois.name: När Hembygdsgård
pois.note:
NÄR HALLSARVE 451, This is the most luxurious Angel Station. 
You get to sleep in real beds in an old stable. 
There is also access to a toilet and shower.
 Its also possible to charge electrical equipment
 If you're lucky, you'll meet the nice host couple Maria and Lars.

pois.name: ICA Nära Sudrets livs - 1k right offroute
Sjövärnsgården
pois.note:
The island's southernmost building..
There are 2, 6-bed rooms upstairs dedicated to you runners. 
Food and drinks are available in the shared kitchen. 
There are showers and toilets. 
If you arrive late in the evening, during the night or early in the morning, 
remember to be quiet so that you don't wake up the other guests.
